scope: Schedule-aware absence, concern and selective searches
Grounded dialogue and actual completed-action evidence
Greetings, joining, interruptions and natural conversation endings
constraints: No global per-person or per-conversation simulation
No LLM requests outside audible nearby interaction; retain queue backpressure
Preserve actual item identity, mass, ownership and player edits
No advanced hunting, geographical features or new model downloads
Build B, protect selected A; game LEFTMOST; final concise screenshot PDF
acceptance: Normal foraging/water/fuel outing does not create missing incidents before expected return
Overdue party creates concern without revealing present location or death; duty/risk/daylight/personality affect searching
Rumour alone does not automatically launch a search; actual return or credible returned report resolves concern
Dialogue separates firsthand, reported, planned and completed facts and focuses on current speaker/question
Full actual camp cycle conserves goods and reuses original materials; off-screen known-group progress never reseeds stock
Conversation joins/interruptions/ending release holds and keep direct player requests ahead of ambient work
